description: Eight notes set by knob in any temperament from 1 to 34 notes per octave, each on its own output and together on a polyphonic one

params.text: Sets that note within the octave, from 0 up to one less than the notes-per-octave setting
Sets the octave of that note, -4 to +4
Sets the temperament, 1 to 34 notes in the octave, starting at 12
Sets how many of the eight notes the polyphonic output carries, 1 to 8; a blue lamp marks each note being sent

outputs.text: Carries that note's pitch on its own, at a volt per octave
Carries the notes within the channel count as one polyphonic signal, at a volt per octave
